data.one_liner: Multi-instance debounce utility for Dart with custom durations and execution controls.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Debouncer class that allows managing multiple debounce instances without a singleton pattern. It supports custom timer durations, init/end hooks, guaranteed sequential execution, and timer status checks.
use_when: You need to debounce user inputs or button presses
You require multiple independent debouncer instances
avoid_when: You are looking for stream-based debouncing operators
strengths: Includes initialization and end callback hooks
Provides guaranteed execution after debounce finishes
weaknesses: Manual disposal of timers may be required to avoid errors
